method: Cell-constant depth sampled on .005m grid; Gaussian derivative smoothing sigma .02m; largest rising depth gradient x[2.2,3.5] per y[-.8,-.4]. Robust line rejects >.08m residual; >=10 rows, slope>.05m/m. Normal states average a .08m tangent band at +/- .10m. Diagnostic orientation/speed, not a measured shock map or exact Rankine-Hugoniot test. Centered differences give front speed; tangential flow and unsteadiness can violate 1D jump assumptions.
